print_config_tree: print a Hydra DictConfig as a rich tree structure to the console with optional file export
print_config_tree_resolve: print a Hydra DictConfig tree with resolved reference fields using the rich library
print_config_tree_save: print and save a Hydra DictConfig tree to a log file in the hydra output folder
enforce_tags_prompt: prompt the user to enter comma separated tags when none are provided in the Hydra config
enforce_tags_save: enforce tags on a Hydra DictConfig and save them to a tags log file
